posts.title: Welcome & About
posts.excerpt:
TLDR:
It will come as no surprise to anyone who follows LaurenApple666 on TikTok that I've decided to start a blog. This is my space for rants, thought dumps and journaling.
posts.body:
# Yoyoyo
See, the thing is- sometimes I fancy livestreaming, sometimes I fancy recording TikToks, sometimes I fancy writing and sometimes I fancy drawing/painting. I shall do it ALL. ✨

OOOBVIOUSLY I had to create something bespoke to cater for the ridiculously random range of topics that I'll inevitably end up writing about😉.  There will be no posting schedule, but there is a subscribe button. I've organised it so you can limit it to topics of interest. For those of you that aren't big readers (or neurodivergents!), I will provide a "TLDR" (too long, didn't read). I also plan to record videos of my blog posts on Youtube if you prefer a video format. I'll also share the videos here on my site somewhere... (we'll cross that bridge when it comes to it eh? 🤭). 
YT: https://www.youtube.com/@LaurenAppL

xoxo
Lozza
